author: BobandVagene
quote: To be fair this is probably an objective 4 to 5, but it gets 1 or even 0 for dragging through the mud the franchise of GTA in search of a non existent modern audience. Only normies will consume this “product” as they like to call it. I’m not even getting into to the nitty gritty of things wrong with this, they’re self evident for anyone that isn’t a bot even before the game launched.
